ChatGPT said:

This is getting much closer to what I think you have in mind.

The dice-set selector at the top now shows the actual configuration:

  • 🔴 Left die — Top 5 / Front 2

  • 🟢 Right die — Top 4 / Front 6

And the saved sets on the left are represented by the actual Top/Front faces, rather than arbitrary names like “Set A.”

I especially like the idea of the app remembering your previously entered configurations so you can simply tap the picture of the dice set to select it.

One correction I'd make to this mockup: the six result buttons should always show 1–6 for both dice. The physical dice-set orientation determines the set; the result buttons record what each die actually shows after the roll.

The basic workflow would be

Select your physical dice set

🔴 Top 5 / Front 2
🟢 Top 4 / Front 6

↓

Start Session

↓

6 × 6 grid appears

↓

Roll the dice.

Tap:

LEFT: 4
RIGHT: 2

↓

The 4–2 cell increments from 6 → 7.

That's it. Two taps per roll.

And all the raw rolls are retained so later we can calculate things like hardways, easy ways, 7s, outside numbers, etc., without making you enter any of that during play.
